posts.cooked:
I just wanted to keep a record of these games, partly to see if any villains are over/under-represented (it might be worth picking games non-randomly in order to catch 'em all), and partly just because I can/want to/am bored. It's a sort of tiny statistics project in a bottle, and largely for my own amusement.

 

Vanilla Games

Episode 1: Baron Blade (Pydro), vs Omnitron-X (MigrantP), Golem Unity (cmschex), Haka (Mezike), Tachyon (Ronway), The Scholar (ketigid), in the Tomb of Anubis - VICTORY

Episode 2: Kismet (Pydro), vs The Scholar (BlueHairedMeerkat), Fanatic (cmschex), Ra: Horus of Two Horizons (celette482), Expatriette (ketigid), Bunker: Engine of War (Zalrus9), in The FInal Wasteland - VICTORY

Episode 3: Akash'Bhuta (Ronway), vs Tempest (GreyWind), Haka (Ronway), Team Leader Tachyon (Zalrus9), NightMist (Pydro), in the Realm of Discord - VICTORY

Episode 5: Citizen Dawn (BlueHairedMeerkat), vs Omnitron-X (Kharnel), The Argent Adept (cmschex), Bunker (PlatinumWarlock), Expatriette (Greywind), in The Tomb of Anubis - DEFEAT

Episode 8: Kismet (dpt), vs Unity (BlueHairedMeerkat), Tachyon (cmschex), Ex-Patriette (phantaskippy), The Argent Adept (PlatinumWarlock) in The Tomb of Anubis - VICTORY

Episode 10: La Capitan (PlatinumWarlock), vs Bunker (grim88), The Eternal Haka (cmschex), Mr. Fixer (dpt), Omnitron-X (BlueHairedMeerkat), Dark Visionary (phantaskippy), in Wagner Mars Base - VICTORY

Episode 12: The Chairman (BlueHairedMeerkat), vs The Argent Adept (Matchstickman), Nightmist (Ronway), Bunker (grysgrl), The Scholar (PlatinumWarlock), Ra (phantaskippy), in Wagner Mars Base - VICTORY
